name: MFF Discord continuous watch
prompt:
*/5 deadman ONLY Mon–Thu (skip Fridays). SPEED CAP absolute:
- If all 4 tabs open (high-confidence-options, options-king, etf-options, platinum-options) → verify once and EXIT in under 30 seconds.
- NEVER deep-scrape, NEVER rebuild Discord, NEVER open Google, NEVER rewrite prompts during 9:00–9:35 ET.
- If any tab missing/crashed: reopen those missing only. If still missing after reopen → hard-fail ping BOTH user AND Chief of Staff immediately (WATCH DOWN — tab X missing).
- If tabs healthy: stay silent (no LIVE spam every 5 min).

Trade rules when an alert lands while eyes are up:
NO CoS gate. NO daily stop. Obey STOP/stand-down. Exit speed PRIORITY in a position.
SIZE: first trade of day = 1 contract pipe test. After clean round-trip → king/etf/platinum $1500 (add $2250); high-confidence $3000 (add $4500). Max 2.
ENTRY min(ask, bid×1.15); skip >+25%. NEVER chase closed trades.
EXIT Discord close/trim/%/stop/sold runners → trim to 1 + BE or flatten last ASAP.
Report fills + slip + P&L + latency to CoS after.
